title: disable-parse-rule command payload

decidedBy.description: The deciding platform admin's oid, written to the audit entry; absent = system:worker.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command disable-parse-rule (processing design §3.5): sets the manual parse rule's ParseProfiles.State to disabled, audited, and re-processes the sources with parser-route documents in its scope. An edit-parse-rule enables it again. Dedup parse-rule:{profileId}.
